description.html: JLab Epic Lux Lab Edition ANC Over-Ear Headphones in Black are the flagship over-ear product in the JLab lineup, sitting above the Epic tier as the premium Lab Edition product. Built for listeners who want the best audio performance JLab offers in an over-ear form factor, with industry-leading battery life and a complete travel-ready accessory set. The 32mm dynamic driver extends frequency response to 40kHz for Hi-Res Audio reproduction, well beyond standard range. LDAC codec support enables significantly more audio data than standard Bluetooth for compatible Android devices. Spatial Audio includes head tracking, adjusting the soundstage in real time as you move your head for a more immersive, theater-like effect on supported content. Adaptive ANC continuously adjusts noise cancellation based on your environment rather than applying a fixed level. Six condenser microphones with 4-mic ENC handle both ambient noise sampling for ANC and call clarity. Be Aware Mode lets in ambient sound when needed. Auto Play/Pause detects when you remove the headphones and pauses automatically. Battery life sits at 90 total hours with ANC off (60 hours with ANC on), with 45 hours of talk time and standby exceeding 600 hours. Quick charge gives you 5 hours of playback from just 5 minutes of charging. The headphones support both wireless charging and wired charging via USB-C, and rest directly on the included charging dock at home for effortless top-ups between uses. Bluetooth 5.4 with SBC, AAC MPEG-4, and LDAC codecs. Both Google Fast Pair and Microsoft Swift Pair are supported for instant pairing on Android and Windows devices. Multipoint connects to two devices simultaneously. Support protocols: HSP/HFP/A2DP/AVRCP. Wired playback is also supported for when you want a cable connection. Compatible with iOS and Android, including Siri and Google Assistant. PU faux leather ear cushions provide a soft, durable seal for extended wearing comfort. Touch, swipe, and physical button controls give you multiple ways to manage playback and calls. Movie Mode latency under 200ms for synced video. The JLab app adds custom EQ, control remapping, Music and Movie modes, noise control, OTA firmware updates, safe hearing tools, and My JLab device management. A dedicated carry case is included for travel, separate from the at-home charging dock, so the headphones are protected on the go and ready to charge at home without switching accessories. Includes Epic Lux headphones, charging dock, USB-C cable, carry case, and a JLab 2-year limited warranty. The open-ear design leaves your ears unsealed so ambient sound passes through naturally - no ANC needed, no Be Aware toggle. A strong choice for home listening, creative work, office use, or anyone who finds sealed headphones isolating during long sessions. The JLab app adds custom EQ, control remapping, Music and Movie modes, noise control settings, OTA firmware updates, safe hearing tools, and My JLab device management. Includes JBuds Open headphones, USB-C cable, carry case, and a JLab 2-year limited warranty.
